[description]
In the upcoming NFL football game between Cowboys and Eagles, scheduled for October 26 at 8:15 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Cowboys" if the Cowboys win the game by 2 or more points.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "Eagles".

Overtime is included if played.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
